summary: Interacting with certain villagers with the villager trade rebalance enabled causes client crash
description: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, if that villager s career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items (e.g. plains armorer), then the game will crash. To reproduce: - Create a new world. Make sure the villager trade rebalance is enabled. - Level an armorer up to either expert (does not apply to expert level taiga villagers) or master level. - Save and quit the world. - Reopen the world. - Interact with the armorer. - The game will crash. I ve also attached both a crash report from a vanilla client and one that is deobfuscated with the official mappings.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world.
2. Ensure the villager trade rebalance is enabled.
3. Level an armorer to either expert or master level.
4. Save and quit the world.
5. Reopen the world.
6. Interact with the armorer.
7. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: When interacting with certain villagers, specifically those whose career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades selling enchanted items (such as plains armorer), the game will crash if the villager trade rebalance feature is enabled. To reproduce this issue, create a new world and ensure that the villager trade rebalance is activated. Next, level an armorer up to either expert or master level (note that this does not apply to expert-level taiga villagers). Save and quit the world, then reopen it and interact with the armorer again. The game will crash upon interaction. For additional context, both a vanilla client crash report and a deobfuscated crash report using official mappings have been attached for further analysis.
Expected Behavior: When interacting with an armorer villager at expert or master level, with the villager trade rebalance enabled, the game should allow trading for enchanted items without causing any crashes. The trades should function normally, allowing players to exchange emeralds for enchanted armor pieces as expected, without any stability issues.
